cult_leadership.origin: Disowned Bramble family member from Greenfields Vale
motivation_notes: Discovered Bramble family's tithe pact with Pumpkin King
Refused to sacrifice her child as required by pact
Fled with followers to break curse using forbidden necromancy
Desperate; multiple failed ritual attempts documented
Willing to sacrifice innocents to end larger curse
harm_evidence: Dried blood and restraints in NIG03
motive_evidence: Research notes on curse reversal methods
Letters to Greenfields Vale seeking allies

pumpkin_king: Mayor Tilda Bramble (HFG001) mentions 'my sister who fled'
Cathedral altar inscription matches Churchyard Shrine (VO001)
Miriam is disowned Bramble; knows First Tithe lore
Red is Pumpkin King enforcer sent to stop cult
thornwood: Druid circle beneath cathedral same as corrupted woods (NCW001)
Father Aldric mentions 'brothers who fled east'
Third Path requires Thornwood artifacts OR druid lore
Withered Hart knows of 'the breakaway cult'

ring_thread.ring_purpose: One of 2 rings needed to break Pumpkin King's pact
ring_thread.ring_lore: Ancient druidic artifacts that can sever tithe bonds

cold_start.summary: Party enters Night_of_the_Restless_Dead with no prior continuity context. Present the opening conflict and immediate objective clearly.

partial_context.summary: Party enters Night_of_the_Restless_Dead with partial prior context. Reinforce known clues before branch-critical decisions.

late_arc.summary: Party enters Night_of_the_Restless_Dead in late-arc state. Provide compact recap and maintain path to a valid ending.

cross_module_refs.notes: Bramble family lineage appears in linked module arcs.
Pumpkin King and harvest pact are shared continuity anchors.
Malarok/old debt threads bridge northern and southern arcs.
Withered Hart lore links to wider covenant/debt continuity.

standalone_fallback.notes: Night_of_the_Restless_Dead remains fully playable as a standalone module when cross-module continuity is unavailable.
